answer: WNT2+ and PEAR1+ prenatal fibroblasts are characterized by genes involved in cellular senescence (CDKN1A), cytokine pathways (IL1R1), and collagen deposition (POSTN). Late gestation WNT2+ fibroblasts have upregulated genes related to extracellular matrix and collagen deposition (COL1A1), while early WNT2+ fibroblasts have differentially expressed genes involved in cellular growth and differentiation (SFRP1). Both populations also express pro-inflammatory genes (APOE, IGFBP7, ITM2A).
